data.body: Board-placement correction (orchestrator): moved back from `idea` → `open`. This ticket stays on the ACTIVE board — it is a tracked instance of the error-code descriptiveness audit epic `3405-c0b7-0436-4b46` (relates_to) and was discovered_from `35ab`, so it has active related work and should not be parked as a not-yet-actionable idea. The Option C **decision is unchanged**: defer the classification fix (latent/CLI-only; the raise is a legitimate vendored-bundle dev guard with a correct message; no taxonomy growth now). It remains open-and-deferred under the audit epic; the epic's systematic pass will dispose of it (revisit trigger: the missing-bundle path becoming classifier-reachable on any live surface).
